# Timer.Coffee
> Timer.Coffee is a free, open-source coffee brewing timer and recipe guide with step-by-step methods, a brew diary, and AI-assisted bean logging.

Timer.Coffee is the marketing and content site for the app. Public content lives on the landing page, recipes, blog, and roaster directory. Internal or admin endpoints are out of scope for LLM usage (for example /admin/, /studio/, /api/).

Common URL patterns:
- https://www.timer.coffee/recipes/
- https://www.timer.coffee/recipes/{method}/
- https://www.timer.coffee/recipes/{method}/{recipe}/
- https://www.timer.coffee/blog/
- https://www.timer.coffee/blog/{slug}/
- https://www.timer.coffee/roasters/
- https://www.timer.coffee/roasters/{slug}/

## Core pages
- [Home](https://www.timer.coffee/): Product overview and feature highlights.
- [Get the app](https://www.timer.coffee/get/): Official download links.
- [Recipes](https://www.timer.coffee/recipes/): Brew methods and recipe index.
- [Blog](https://www.timer.coffee/blog/): Articles and release notes.
- [Roasters](https://www.timer.coffee/roasters/): Public coffee roaster directory.
- [App privacy](https://www.timer.coffee/app-privacy/): Privacy policy.

## Indices
- [Sitemap](https://www.timer.coffee/sitemap.xml): Main public URL index.
- [Roasters sitemap](https://www.timer.coffee/roasters-sitemap.xml): Public roaster profile URL index.

## Apps and source
- [Web app](https://app.timer.coffee/): Browser version of Timer.Coffee.
- [iOS App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6449322787): iOS listing with brew diary and bean tracking details.
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.coffee.timer): Android listing.
- [Open-source app repo](https://github.com/antonkarliner/timer-coffee): App source code and full feature list.

## Optional
- [Blog feed](https://www.timer.coffee/feed.xml/): RSS/Atom feed.
- [Support the project](https://buymeacoffee.com/timercoffee): Optional donations.
- App languages (as of April 19, 2026; App Store): English, Arabic, Croatian, Dutch, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian Bokmal, Persian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Turkish, Ukrainian. If this date is old, see the iOS App Store listing for the latest languages.
